vulnerable_code:
from rest_framework import viewsets
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.filters import SearchFilter
from rest_framework_guardian.filters import ObjectPermissionsFilter
from .models import ConfidentialDossier
from .serializers import ConfidentialDossierSerializer
from .permissions import GuardianObjectPermission

class ConfidentialDossierViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = ConfidentialDossier.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ConfidentialDossierSerializer
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, GuardianObjectPermission]
    filter_backends = [SearchFilter]  # Missing ObjectPermissionsFilter in filter_backends
    search_fields = ['title', 'case_id']
diagnosis: ConfidentialDossierViewSet defines GuardianObjectPermission which calls check_object_permissions on detail endpoints (retrieve, update). However, filter_backends only includes SearchFilter and omits ObjectPermissionsFilter. Because DRF does not run object permission checks on list endpoints, GET /api/dossiers/ returns all confidential records in the database across all organizations, bypassing django-guardian's row-level permissions entirely.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework import viewsets
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.filters import SearchFilter
from rest_framework_guardian.filters import ObjectPermissionsFilter
from .models import ConfidentialDossier
from .serializers import ConfidentialDossierSerializer
from .permissions import GuardianObjectPermission

class ConfidentialDossierViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = ConfidentialDossier.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ConfidentialDossierSerializer
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, GuardianObjectPermission]
    filter_backends = [SearchFilter, ObjectPermissionsFilter]
    search_fields = ['title', 'case_id']
